title: Luxury 4BR w/ Rooftop, Hot Tub, 4 Mins to Broadway
description:
This luxury 4BR is built for bachelorettes, big groups, and families looking to enjoy Nashville in style. Relax on your private rooftop 🌅, unwind in the hot tub ♨️, and enjoy 3 spacious floors—just a quick 4-min Uber to Broadway 🎶. Quiet, growing area with easy parking 🚗 and simple rideshare access.

Perfect for:
✨ Bachelorettes
✨ Birthday trips
✨ Girls’ weekends
✨ Family celebrations
✨ Group getaways

The space
Bedroom 1 (first floor): Bunk bed (full and twin)
Bedroom 2 (second floor): Queen bed
Bedroom 3 (second floor): Queen bed
Bedroom 4 (second floor): King bed
Other options: Sleeper sofa and queen air mattress
Loft (third floor): Queen bed
Dedicated Workspace (first floor)

Full Bathroom 1 (First Floor)
Full Bathroom 2 (Second Floor)
Full Bathroom 3 (Second Floor)

Guest access
Guest can access the property via keyless entry and and the entire house will be available for guests access.

Other things to note
2-Car gated garage, with room to park 4 vehicles or small camper, also additional *FREE* Street Parking in Front of the HOME

*DISCLAIMER* THIS IS A DEVELOPING NEIGHBORHOOD IN DOWNTOWN NASHVILLE. Please reach out to the Host if you have any questions or concerns about the neighborhood, we will be happy to answer any questions.

*NOT A WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD….YET :-). We'll provide a $15 Uber credit for your first ride. 

*CODE WORD: 7STAYS
